messages:
Riya Patel: Heads up — CNTR ETA GLR-7 arrived at bay 3 but manifest shows water damage. ~40% of pallets marked 'suspect'. Affected SKUs: rtx-a5000-48, rtx-a6000-24. This impacts 3 Dedicated reservations (CUST-112, CUST-395, CUST-402) scheduled for next-week staging.

Diego: yikes. Any photos/manifest notes?

Riya Patel: pics uploaded to GDrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cX. Warehouse flagged 8 pallets as soaked, inventory tag notes: 'corrosion risk'.

warehouse-bot: container 0xC77 flagged quarantine. Holding 8 pallets. @logistics-team please confirm.

Sam K: what's the replacement lead time if we swap to alternate supplier? Also need to notify sales/customer success — we have SLA penalties if we miss start-of-month commit.

Elena (sales): confirmed, CUST-112 and CUST-395 have start dates locked. If we slip >48h they'll request credits. Need mitigation plan within 6h.

Ava: options: 1) cross-region swap — pull available GPUs from EU spare pool (adds ~12h transit). 2) expedite partial replacement from partner B (lead time 3 business days). 3) enable canary fallback to a compatible quantized model variant (software mitigation) to buy time.

Diego: check EU spare pool counts: `eu-spare: rtx-a5000-12, rtx-a6000-8` — not enough to cover full demand (need rtx-a5000-24, a6000-16). Could cover CUST-402 + partial for CUST-395.

Riya Patel: quick ask to partner A: can they split the manifest and prioritize shipping dry pallets by air? If yes, we can hold partial allocations and avoid broad customer impact.

Sam K: I'll call partner A rep (+1-555-0123) and ask for partial airlift option. Also drafting customer comms: short ETA risk + mitigation.

Elena (sales): please cc legal on any credits. Looping PMs: @product-ops — is the canary fallback acceptable QA-wise for these customers?

Ava: product-ops says fallback acceptable for non-critical workloads, they want a small eval run (5k tokens) to validate regression before enabling.

warehouse-bot: quarantine clearance delayed pending partner photos — clearance ETA +4h.

Diego: plan proposal: immediate partial reallocation — move EU spare to cover CUST-402 fully, enable canary fallback for CUST-112 + CUST-395 while Sam secures partial airlift. If partner refuses airlift, escalate to reserved-capacity swap with marketplace (ticket created: #MP-8891).

Riya Patel: +1. I'll update the reservation mapping doc and tag @eng-ops for routing changes. Filing an incident in #incidents.

Sam K: on call with partner in 15, will post outcome.

Elena (sales): prepping customer emails now — short + transparent. Thanks team :pray:.

Ava: action items: Diego (verify EU pool movement), Riya (update reservations + incidents), Sam (partner call), Elena (customer comms), warehouse-bot (update status). Reconvene in 2h or earlier if partner confirms.

Sam K: partner confirmed they can airlift 4 dry pallets within 48h and will prioritize CUST-112. They request an expedited fee.

Elena (sales): approve expedited fee up to $8k if it avoids SLA credits. Tagging finance for release.

warehouse-bot: status update: 4 pallets cleared, 4 still quarantined.

Diego: moving forward with EU->NA transfer for CUST-402 tonight, Sam to finalize airlift contract for CUST-112, Riya to remap reservations and update the console routing rules.

Riya Patel: I'll post the reservation remap and updated SLO risk in #incidents and ping customers with the approved mitigation notes.

Sam K: call summary: partner to ship 4 pallets expedited, returns & photos expected within 24h, marketplace swap ticket #MP-8891 open as fallback.

Elena (sales): customer comms sent for CUST-112 + CUST-395 with canary fallback option and proposed timeline.

Ava: thanks — keeping this thread as source-of-truth.

warehouse-bot: final status note: quarantine reduced to 4 pallets, clearance ongoing."
